message.content:
Let me understand the vulnerability. The `proxy_header_v2` struct has a union of `ip4` (12 bytes) and `ip6` (36 bytes). The struct size is 16 + 36 = 52 bytes.

The check is `size > sizeof(*hdr)` where `sizeof(*hdr)` = 52. So `size` can be up to 52. But the actual data read depends on `hdr->fam`. If `fam == TCP4`, only 12 bytes of the union are read. If `fam == TCP6`, 36 bytes are read.

Wait, the vulnerability is about the buffer not being large enough. Let me look at how the buffer is allocated and how much data is read into it. Let me look at the caller.
